text: Definitely my personal favorite game of 2026. I already finished it completely on console and it runs even better on my laptop. The story is fantastic, the graphics are amazing and the new absolute difficulty really adds a challenge to the game.
One of the most engaging games I’ve played. The parkour is so good in this game. Love it! I regret leaving it in my backlog for 2 years.

The game definitely has the potential, but the developers must fix some design issues, for example add a map and normal way to save the game instead of checkpoints. Replaying the same area many times is simply annoying.

Pretty much a run of the mill indie title. 

The gameplay is frustrating. Violates the golden rule of atmospheric horror is that the player should be given the time to figure out what's going on and what to do before the spooky bad guys show up. 

This game doesn't do that what so ever and immediately cuts the tension I was feeling coming out of the pitfall room. It relies heavily on trial and error which is a extreme problem since the devs don't give you any direction as to what you'll be facing couple this with the fact that there is no saving mechanic even if the game is short. 

So, if you're not in a mood to repeatedly get sent back to the little hub trying to figure out what the devs want you to do then pass this game by even at four dollars there's better games probably on sale.

Absolutely loved this game to start. Hooked me, the enemies and bosses were the right amount of difficulty, and the combat is fantastic.
I have this feeling that the level design (both artistically and mechanic wise) did fall off for me though. No level really looked as good as the first one, and the enemies and mechanics introduced later didn't really hit home for me.
The final boss is also an absolute PITA, had to use a guide to finally beat him.
I do recommend this game for anyone that's into a souls-like type experience.

Furi is a boss-rush / bullet hell game, where you are up against varied opponents, attempting to make your way out of your captivity.

The art style and music are great, and the game never feels like its taking cheap shots during gameplay.  This is definitely a git gud kind of game, and it is satisfying to overcome each obsticle.  I enjoy coming back to this game every few years and have another go, of course after my skills decline, because I guess I like punishment!

Well worth the time and effort if you're into this type of genere.

This game had high praise on release so I was excited to try it out. It unfrotunately did not live up to my expectations. This game feels 'almost good' or 'almost fun'. The Devs strugle with their idea of balancing and making the game actually fun to play and from my persepective there are too many instances they don't succeed. There are so many mechanics that feel frustrating to use, reloading your gun, 90% of guns feel useless, new tank can't turn it's turret etc. Max level difficulty is inconsistent, sometimes challenging sometimes easy. Maps and terrain feel repetetive, flat and uninteresting to play on, verticality in movement and map design is barely explored.
Bought it on sale years ago and forgot about it until recently. Really great game with a great soundtrack. Don't skip this one.

I had this game for a very long time, and finally decided to play it on my Steam Deck. Absotutely loved it, and immediately added to my favourites. The story, the art style, the depiction of the World War I, are just moving. It also runs greatly on Steam Deck, except one particular "boss fight" where I had to increase FPS cap for certain scripted events to work.

It's Bioshock, a game with a great story and fairly straight forward gameplay that is entertaining. Embrace rapture with an open mind, and would you kindly, be careful when swinging golf clubs while in doors.

Amazing and addicting roguelike Cardgame. If you decide to play it, just be aware it can take a few minutes up to an hour to roughly understand what you are doing. Thats when the fun begins.

One of the best games of recent times in my opinion. Insane replay value.

This game runs unbelievably poorly, to start. James is a nightmare to control. His flashlight is a joke. Enemies clip through geometry. Level design is trite.

The story and atmosphere are actually super compelling, but the gameplay is so miserable that I couldn't really stay immersed and enjoy the whole experience. Still, we finished the game because my partner and I enjoy the SH universe.

Yes! This game is amazing! I love the concept of having monsters sing to you! there is so much things to do in this game. I currently have a playtime of over 30 hours and I never got bored a single second! There are updates quite frequently (2-3 updates per month), The game has a community so united and kind and inspirational, and if you're somehow getting bored one time... then try to participate in the community events that happen in the game! If You're still lost on how to play or everything is just confusing then don't worry cause there are tons of youtubers that you can take notes from. This game is Definitely recommended. If you're looking for a new game to play then I think you found it!

One of the best story and action game I have every played. With unique combat systems and a very simple yet interesting story, Pragmata proves itself worthy of being ranked at the top of my game leaderboard.

Note: I played trough the entire story without encountering a single bug and the framerate at almost maxxed out 
graphic settings 4k was amazing.
